Party row names, keys and numeric parser conversion; three return values sum serialized rows.
Empty top is empty string, topdps is numeric zero.
Receiving a new snapshot replaces the cache; old references remain old; getters return the actual cache.
Alive down=0 is numeric zero and truthy in Lua; optional fields absent.
Downed share/by; empty by string; active reviving/rshare; empty resets.

limits: Raw imports omit original external data/callee bodies and use generic x86_64 ABI; original Win64 instructions and PE constants govern signature/data interpretations.
Pointer and slice records are not original type names; native row producers are recovered, complete co-op simulation and network behavior are outside this scope.
Interpreted cases use synthetic payloads and explicit host seams, not an application run or a network/visual/parity check.
